Class Specific Traits.name: High Ground
Class Specific Traits.desc: Passive: Your damage dealt with a bow is increased when above your target.

Racial Combat Abilities.name: Tenacity
Racial Combat Abilities.desc: Passive: Your resistance to Mesmerize and Incapacitate is increased by 15%. Active: Become tenacious, removing all Mesmerize and Incapacitate effects and granting you immunity to them for 15 seconds.

Racial Combat Abilities.name: Hide
Racial Combat Abilities.desc: Active: Slip into the shadows, rendering you unseen by the living. This ability is removed by movement and actions.

Racial Combat Abilities.name: Bribe
Racial Combat Abilities.desc: Active: Bribe your target, causing them to forget past wrongdoings.

Racial Combat Abilities.name: Ogre Smash
Racial Combat Abilities.desc: Active: Forcefully smash nearby targets, stunning them for 2 seconds.

Racial Combat Abilities.name: Slippery
Racial Combat Abilities.desc: Passive: Root resistance increased by 15%. Active: Become slippery, removing all Root and Snare effects and granting you immunity to them for 15 seconds.

Racial Combat Abilities.name: Stone Form
Racial Combat Abilities.desc: Active: Turn to stone, removing all harmful Disease, Electricity, and Poison effects and increasing your resistance to them, reducing your Physical Damage received by 10%, and increasing your Armor Class by 25% for 15 seconds.
